name: Cone of Cards
body:
School: evocation [Force]; Level: jester 1

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 standard action

Prop: Cards

EFFECT

Range: 15 ft.

Area: Cone-shaped burst

Duration: Instantaneous

Saving Throw: Reflex half; Spell Resistance: yes

DESCRIPTION

A cone of force cards shoots from your hands. Each creature in the area takes 1d4 points of force damage.
